label: L-11
title: totalBalanceOf and principalOf use different data sources — live vault price vs. static accounting value — creating inconsistent paired views that can return negative yield for downstream integrators
description: totalBalanceOf returns a vault-price-sensitive value while principalOf returns a static clientBalances value. After a vault price decline, totalBalanceOf < principalOf. Any integrating contract computing totalBalanceOf - principalOf as a yield signal receives a negative value, potentially reverting on unchecked underflow or triggering incorrect downstream logic.
impact: Low severity in isolation; elevated risk for downstream protocols that assume totalBalanceOf >= principalOf as an invariant. No fund loss in the strategy itself.
attackPath: Vault price declines (e.g., vault depegs or accrual reversal)
totalBalanceOf returns vault-price-sensitive value < principalOf (static clientBalances)
Integrating contract computing totalBalanceOf - principalOf gets arithmetic underflow or negative yield signal
Downstream logic branches incorrectly or reverts
